name: Cooked Sliced Beef Donair Loaf
paragraphs: Our fully cooked sliced halal beef donair loaves are deliciously authentic, mildly spicy, and full of flavour. Our fully cooked beef donair loaves come in a convenient pack for school cafeterias, retail delis, local restaurants, and the frozen aisle in grocery stores. This convenient 1 kg pack makes transporting the loaves home easy so that you can make the perfect pizzas, poutines, and sandwiches with your family!
